collection.title: VW Touran 2006 to 2007 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The VW Touran 2006 to 2007 model requires a 24" wiper blade on both the drivers side and a 19" blade for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Touran, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
